From Rockstar's pre-load announcement: GTA VI will also be available through Xbox Cloud Gaming on Xbox Series X|S and Xbox One consoles, using Xbox Series S graphics settings, and it supports Remote Play on PlayStation and Xbox. Cloud performance depends on your connection.

—

Do anúncio de pré-download da Rockstar: GTA VI também estará disponível via Xbox Cloud Gaming no Xbox Series X|S e no Xbox One, usando as configurações gráficas do Xbox Series S, e terá suporte a Remote Play no PlayStation e no Xbox. O desempenho na nuvem depende da sua conexão.
